added.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
added.description:
تبحث شركة ألفا عشرون (Alpha Twenty)، المتخصصة في التسويق والإعلان والحلول الإبداعية بمدينة جدة، عن أخصائي استراتيجية تسويق (Marketing Strategist) يمتلك التفكير الاستراتيجي والقدرة على تحليل الأسواق وتطوير استراتيجيات تسويقية مبتكرة تساهم في نمو أعمال العملاء وتحقيق أهدافهم التجارية.
نبحث عن شخصية طموحة ومبادرة، قادرة على تحويل البيانات والرؤى التسويقية إلى خطط عملية قابلة للتنفيذ والقياس، والمساهمة في تطوير الحلول التسويقية وتعزيز تنافسية الشركة.
المسؤوليات تطوير استراتيجيات تسويقية متكاملة تتوافق مع أهداف العملاء واحتياجاتهم التجارية.
إجراء دراسات السوق وتحليل المنافسين والجمهور المستهدف وتحديد الفرص التسويقية.
إعداد الخطط التسويقية والحملات الإعلانية وتحديد الأهداف ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs).
تطوير استراتيجيات المحتوى والتواصل التسويقي بما يتناسب مع هوية كل علامة تجارية.
التعاون مع فرق الإبداع والتصميم والإنتاج لضمان تحويل الاستراتيجيات إلى مخرجات فعالة.
تحليل نتائج الحملات التسويقية وتقديم توصيات لتحسين الأداء والعائد على الاستثمار.
إعداد العروض الاستراتيجية والتسويقية وتقديمها للعملاء بصورة احترافية.
المساهمة في تطوير العروض التجارية واستقطاب العملاء من خلال تقديم حلول تسويقية مبتكرة.
متابعة الاتجاهات الحديثة في التسويق الرقمي وتوظيف الأدوات والتقنيات الحديثة لتحسين النتائج.
إدارة الأولويات والالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة وجودة المخرجات.

المؤهلات والمتطلبات درجة البكالوريوس في التسويق أو إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة.
خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في إعداد وتطوير الاستراتيجيات التسويقية، ويفضل في وكالات التسويق والإعلان.
فهم متقدم للتسويق الرقمي وسلوك المستهلك وبناء العلامات التجارية.
معرفة جيدة بمنصات Meta Ads وGoogle Ads وTikTok Ads وSnapchat Ads.
القدرة على تحليل البيانات التسويقية وقياس الأداء وتطوير خطط التحسين.
مهارات عالية في التفكير الاستراتيجي والتحليل وحل المشكلات.
القدرة على إعداد العروض التقديمية والتواصل الفعال مع العملاء.
إجادة اللغة العربية والقدرة على التواصل المهني باللغة الإنجليزية.
معرفة جيدة بالسوق السعودي واتجاهاته التسويقية.
امتلاك روح المبادرة والاستقلالية والقدرة على تحمل المسؤولية.

ميزة إضافية:
تقديم نماذج من استراتيجيات تسويقية سابقة مع توضيح النتائج المحققة.
معلومات الوظيفة الموقع: جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية.
نوع العمل: دوام كامل – حضوري.
للتقديم:
يرجى إرفاق السيرة الذاتية ونماذج من الأعمال أو الاستراتيجيات التسويقية السابقة.

added.title: Fractional Influencer Marketing Lead – Crypto & Web3 (GCC)
added.description:
Fractional Influencer Marketing Lead – Crypto & Web3 (GCC)

Company: Discovr AI (getdiscovr.ai)
Location: Remote | Global

About Discovr AI

Discovr AI is an AI-native creator marketing platform that combines specialized AI agents with end-to-end campaign execution.
We work with 30+ enterprise brands across India, the US, and international markets, helping them scale creator marketing through intelligent discovery, outreach, campaign management, brand safety, and performance measurement.

We're expanding our crypto and Web3 creator marketing capabilities globally and looking for an experienced industry specialist to work alongside our team.

About the Role;

We're seeking a Fractional Influencer Marketing Lead / Consultant with hands-on experience managing large-scale creator and KOL marketing programs for cryptocurrency exchanges, trading platforms, and Web3 companies across global markets.
You'll work closely with Discovr's founders and campaign execution team to develop creator strategies, advise on campaign execution, and serve as a subject-matter expert during client engagements.

This is a strategic, client-facing consulting role, not a full-time campaign operations position.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Global Creator Marketing Strategy
Develop influencer and KOL marketing strategies across North America, Europe, LATAM, MENA, and APAC.
Recommend regional creator segments, platforms, content formats, and budget allocation.
Design campaigns focused on brand awareness, user acquisition, and trading activity.
Advise on fixed-fee sponsorships, CPA, affiliate, and revenue-sharing models.

2. Global Crypto Creator Ecosystem
Identify and evaluate relevant crypto influencers across YouTube, X, podcasts, TikTok, and other platforms.
Leverage existing relationships with crypto creators, KOLs, and regional networks.
Benchmark creator pricing, engagement quality, and expected performance across markets.
Advise on creator selection, negotiations, and partnership structures.

3. Client Strategy & Advisory
Participate in client discovery calls and strategic discussions.
Translate client objectives into actionable global and regional creator campaign plans.
Present campaign strategies, budget recommendations, and creator partnership proposals.
Act as a subject-matter expert for Discovr's client-facing and execution teams.

4. Campaign Oversight & Performance
Guide campaign planning, creator briefs, messaging, and content strategy.
Review campaign performance and recommend optimizations.
Establish KPIs around reach, engagement, qualified sign-ups, acquisition, and retention.
Advise on regional crypto advertising regulations, promotional disclosures, and brand safety in coordination with client legal and compliance teams.

Ideal Candidate:

5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or growth marketing.
At least 2 years of direct experience with crypto exchanges, Web3 platforms, or trading-related marketing.
Demonstrated experience managing $100K+ monthly creator marketing budgets.
Strong understanding of the global crypto creator ecosystem, with expertise in multiple geographic markets.
Established relationships with crypto influencers, KOLs, and creator networks.
Experience with both awareness-led sponsorships and performance-driven creator programs.
Comfortable working directly with senior marketing stakeholders and global teams.
Strong communication, strategic thinking, and presentation skills.

How to Apply:

Please share your LinkedIn profile, relevant crypto/Web3 influencer marketing experience, the geographic markets you've managed, and examples of creator campaigns or programs you've led.

Contact: DM us on LinkedIn or email hr@getdiscovr.ai

added.title: Fashion Marketing Manager
added.description:
About The Job

In the context of Dynamic development of the business, the expansion of the client data-base, along with the evolution of Image and Clienteling activities that Chanel experienced in the Middle East, we are looking for Fashion Marketing Manager. As Marketing Manager ME you are responsible for the client marketing strategy within the zone's boutiques.

Working closely with boutiques on a daily basis and in close collaboration with the Fashion Europe Marketing Team, you translate this strategy into concrete, operational actions. You will also support partners boutiques in the ME region.

You will manage a team of 2 persons.

The Impact You Can Create at CHANEL:

CHANEL's vision of client relations in fashion is reflected in its Relational Promise, embodying the fundamental principles that set the brand apart.

Reporting to the Fashion Director, you will oversee the Retail Marketing activities in the Middle East region to drive the Fashion Brands’ Image and enhance Brand vitality and equity.

As a key Business Partner to the Retail Network, you will be responsible for leading ME marketing community to ensure an effective implementation of the marketing strategy in line with the global fashion vision and “One Boutique, one story” signature across ME.

Your main responsibilities are:

Marketing strategy:

Development and execution of Marketing strategy for the Middle East region based on the market challenges and in line with Fashion Global and European vision and guidelines
Work in partnership with Boutique Directors to infuse a client-centric mindset to the teams & define the client engagement & development strategy for each boutique
Marketing Budget planning in line with budget guidelines and Budget monitoring
Partnering with Global and European marketing teams to facilitate synergies and get input for ME marketing plan development and execution

Retail Marketing & Client Experience:

Implementation of the various innovative client services in-store, from welcome to follow-up in partnership with Operations, CED and Learning teams
Implementation of impactful Clienteling culture that reflects Europe strategy
Setting up of Clienteling objectives for each of the boutiques according to their own challenges in close collaboration with CED team and Europe direction
Management of service measurement programs to understand and optimize boutique experiences. Monitoring client satisfaction indicators such as Pulse Index, Voice of Client survey and Competitors Pulse Index, in liaison with the European teams. Definition of the action plan to be implemented to achieve service excellence, always in line with the relational promise and in coordination with the Learning & Style Expertise Manager team
Deployment of strategic client data projects/tools (Pioneer, Carat) in close collaboration with CED team
Deployment of new digital tools related to client experience (Waitwhile, inchanel for example) and ensuring the proper adoption in the boutiques in partnership with Operations and Learning teams. Feedback on needed evolutions to regional teams
Development of Client treatment and gifting strategies
Improvement of hospitality standards in all the boutiques
Prevention of parallel market together with key local contacts at market and Europe level

Events & Top Client Experiences

Development of the impactful Event plan for ME region, reflecting to the overall client strategy and always aligned with budget guidelines from Europe region
In-store and out-store events management in collaboration with local, internal and external partners
Strong collaboration with PR and Media Departments to ensure the coherence and alignment of the Image events
Systematization of the events’ monitoring to measure the impact (quantitative, qualitative, and sustainability)
Productive collaboration with W&FJ division for Fashion boutique events
Definition of the top client strategy across all touchpoints (gifting, services, communication, global and local experiences) together with boutiques and in partnership with Europe region
Further development of the pool of Top clients & guarantee the service excellence through the hospitality network

Animation of Marketing community to implement client relational promise in every boutique

Active participation in Fashion team projects (Fashion seminar, team meeting etc.)

You Are Energized By:

Crafting and executing innovative marketing strategies that elevate brand presence.
Collaborating across teams and regions to drive cohesive and impactful initiatives.
Cultivating client relationships and enhancing their boutique experiences.
Leading a dynamic team towards shared goals and collective success.
Shaping and witnessing the growth and recognition of an iconic luxury brand in the Middle East.

What You Will Bring:

Strong marketing experience ( min 5 years, preferably within luxury brands), knowledge of the luxury retail environment is a plus
Leadership skills that inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence.
Strategic planning and execution capabilities that drive impactful results.
Effective collaboration skills with local, regional, and global teams.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills that foster strong relationships.
An analytical mindset with a focus on impact-driven results.

Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret market research data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

Excellent command of written and spoken English.
